topic: Impression calculation and reporting best practices
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on whether demographic data is included in viewed impressions for campaign reports. It was confirmed that demographics are not factored into the impression count.

Regarding reporting, it was noted that 'viewed impressions' should be used for all graphics in campaign reports. [me] stated that while viewed impressions are only available in totals, there were no issues extracting them into charts.

Due to confusion regarding the requirements (potentially originating from someone named Sergio), a general call was suggested to clarify the reporting needs.
decisions: A general meeting will be scheduled to discuss and clarify reporting requirements.
action_items: Someone will follow up with Galina regarding scheduling the general call.
